text: Nostalgia is a complex emotional experience involving fond memories of the past and mild sadness, characterized by positive emotions associated with reflecting on previous events. It can awaken emotional memories of loved ones or significant events, contributing to an increase in positive emotions. An unresolved question regarding nostalgia is whether different channels of nostalgia input exhibit distinct mechanisms.
source_label: Harmonizing the past: EEG-based brain network unveil modality-specific mechanisms of nostalgia
